parts.text: We currently have 4 active ad campaigns: 1. Blue Floral Maxi Dress - Westfield Century City (Los Angeles, CA); 2. Elegant Black Cocktail Dress - Bloomingdale's 59th Street (New York, NY); 3. Black High Waist Trousers - Water Tower Place (Chicago, IL); 4. Sage Satin Camisole - The Grove (Los Angeles, CA). Each campaign is one product at one store location, and all four are Active.

There are 28 products in the catalog, grouped by category: Dresses, Tops, Pants, Outerwear, and Skirts (fashion), plus Beverages & Food (such as Aurora Cold Brew, Citrus Grove Sparkling Water) and Electronics & Home (such as earbuds, a lounge chair, and an air fryer).
